item.tib: gzhi lam thig pa'i rnams dbye rin chen 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar gzhi lam thig (theg) pa'i rnam dbye rin chen 'phring ('phreng) ba 'di ni/ rgyud lung nas ci ltar gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bshad srol la byung pa rnams/ nyung du bsdus nas go bde bar byas te/ bla ma rin chen 'od zer bas/ yang nas yang du bskul ste/ phyogs med ri khrod pa dpal btsun nams (nam) mkha' bzang po bdag gis bris pa la/ don dang mi mthun 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ blo ldan gong ma rnams la bshags par 'bul/ sems nyid rnam par dag pas bris pa yis/ thos chung blo yi mun pa rab gsal nas/ ci bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyas par shog gser ri g.yu ra'i sbas yul gter gnas ri dmar spungs pa'i yang dben du bris pa dge'o/ g.yung drung bon bstan phyogs bcur dar rgyas shog/
